#!/bin/bash
# AMP: points mission_save at the newest save made in the configured campaign mode, or clears it so a new map starts.
mode=$(sed -n 's/^set campaign "\(.*\)".*/\1/p' "$1")
[ -n "$mode" ] || exit 0
inf=$(grep -laF "campaigns/$mode.campaign" "$2"/*.campaign/*.inf 2>/dev/null | xargs -r -d '\n' ls -t | head -n 1)
name=''
[ -n "$inf" ] && name=$(basename "$inf" .inf | tr -- '-_' '+/' | base64 -d)
esc=$(echo "$name" | sed 's/[\/&]/\\&/g')
sed -i "s/^set mission_save \".*\"/set mission_save \"$esc\"/" "$1"
if [ -n "$name" ]; then echo "[AMP] Loading latest save: $name"; else echo '[AMP] No saves for this campaign mode, starting a new map'; fi
